notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Hello Leprechauns!

We have just updated the game with these changes:
-2 new levels, just before each world boss.
-Improved Job general handling. Jumping feels better now.
-Fixed random bug with moving platforms being stuck sometimes.

Cheers!

notes.title: Job the Leprechaun updated!
notes.notes:
We have just released an update with these new features:
-WASD + N/M keys available.
-OSX and Linux version.
-New level (2-9) in night world.
-Improved movement system in ladders.
-The cow has now a name: Catalina :-)
-Fixed the random freeze bug on bonus stage.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
We have just updated "Job the Leprechaun":

-New level in night world.
-Wider ladders, easier to use.
-Interchangeable 'Z'/'Y' keys for german keyboards.
-Exit game is now not allowed when you are dying.
-Used GM:Studio YoYoCompiler for better performance.

Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9610943/3e5029c73604ef7ff73c4acf6cbd9cd0fa0f5e4f.jpg[/img]
